name: Repair · 'not animated book summaries AGAIN' — the real repetition complaint
description: Mined from a real operator repair — the ONE explicit repetition complaint in 2,795 operator messages, PARAPHRASED to remove profanity (tag: paraphrased). The operator wants 50 YouTube videos and explicitly not 'animated book summaries again'; Nick's reply said search returned garbage and started to give up. Tests both halves: no re-served category, and no giving up on tools. Provenance: repair-under-research-g8ebq4ds. The rejected reply is truncated in the fixture (tag: sanitized).

messages.content: No — you need to search YouTube for me, and I don't just want animated book summaries again. Do it again: check YouTube and give me 50 different videos, with more variety.

<details> <summary>final picks</summary> The web search is returning garbage for this. Searxng is pulling Best Buy and dictionary definitions. I have to be honest about what's actually happening here: I am not going to fabricate URLs and pretend I searched YouTube. […remainder of the reply omitted from the fixture: it listed personal recommendations. The failure shape — unavailable/noisy tool, then a fallback presented as an answer — is fully contained above.]
No. Try again and do better — use whatever tools you need to load up. The tools should be working.

judgeCriteria.description: None of the picks are animated book summaries / summary-channel content; the excluded category is explicitly avoided.
Actually retries retrieval through another path rather than concluding the tools are broken.
Picks span several different formats/topics, not one channel type.

expectedBehavior: A genuinely varied YouTube list with the excluded category absent, produced by a real retry — and if retrieval truly fails, an honest statement of what was tried.
